definitions: To move with great effort and difficulty, often through a resistant medium or situation.
To advance slowly and laboriously against obstacles.
examples: They had to make slow and difficult progress through the deep snow.
The team made slow and difficult progress through the dense jungle.
We made slow and difficult progress through the bureaucratic process.
lemma: to make slow and difficult progress through something
